2724-7638-8172.description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

2173-2813-4740-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2813-4740-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
There's an indestructible artifact on the battlefield.
2173-2813-4740-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

413-6972-7727.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Hulk enters, Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1274-6720-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-6720-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2741-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-3197-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-6156-6754.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-6754.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

955-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
955-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

549-1651-4702-4891.description:
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat

Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

215-4231-6723-6724.description:
Cast The Goose Mother either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When The Goose Mother enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Clue, three Food and three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Foods, three Clues and three Treasures by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning The Goose Mother from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4231-6723-6724.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {2} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo. Otherwise, the token results will be tapped tokens instead of untapped tokens. If you get infinite mana, you can cast The Goose Mother and put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

710-2292-4775.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

586-5626-5686-6112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

413-2517-4681-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
413-2517-4681-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 6, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3146-3537-4279-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3146-3537-4279-4929.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding Voidwing Hybrid, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Voidwing Hybrid triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Bog Initiate twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1367-2788-3634-4568.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast any instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1367-2788-3634-4568.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, creating a copy of Nexus of Fate.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Venser enters the battlefield, returning itself and original Nexus of Fate to your hand.
Resolve the Nexus of Fate copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Repeat.

Archelos is untapped.
It is not your turn.

During an opponent's turn, activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

1475-4802-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-4802-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power that each enter with at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

4222-4410-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Hermetic Study attached to Malcolm.
Malcolm does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4410-4508.description:
Tap Malcolm to deal 1 damage to target opponent, creating a treasure from Malcolm's trigger.
Sacrifice the treasure token for {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real to untap Malcolm.
Repeat.
